asr_text: The 20 percent plan changes overnight. About 24 hours and 48 minutes later, at 11:04 a.m. on July 14th, Trump said the 20 percent plan would be replaced by trade and investment projects between Gulf states and the U.S. He cited "very productive discussions" with Middle Eastern leaders. He also said no one should charge ships in the Strait of Hormuz and that he disliked fees. The change was sudden, but to read the oil move, the dates must be kept separate. On July 13th, Brent rose 9.59 percent and settled at $83.36. Reuters linked that rise to concern about a U.S. sea blockade of Iran planned for the next day and energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
